headings: I invite you to open your heart, trust your intuition, and follow the calling within. My space is here, ready to welcome you.
texts:
I offer gentle, trauma-informed healing modalities that support inner harmony, realignment, and empowerment. Each journey is designed to help you discover purpose and meaning in daily life while deepening your understanding of the multidimensional aspects of your being.

Together, we honour and prioritise wellbeing—reconnecting, reclaiming, and integrating all aspects of the Self: emotional, mental, physical, and spiritual.

As a practitioner, trainer and mentor, my work offers an inner-child-led, trauma-informed, integrative approach to healing, supporting emotional safety, self-awareness and authentic transformation across all stages of the journey. For more details on workshops, one-to-one mentoring and training programs, you are welcome to explore further.

There is a world we can share together—bridging inner landscapes with outer experiences to create harmony and confidence within. When you align with your authentic self, you begin living your purpose with clarity, meaning and joy.

If you’re unsure where to begin, you’re not alone. Many people arrive here feeling a pull toward healing or growth, without yet knowing which path feels right. This gentle guide may help you orient:

New to this work
→ Begin with Inner Child Healing
A supportive starting point to reconnect with your inner world, build safety, and begin healing with care.

Integrating after a workshop or deep experience
→ Inner Child Mentoring
Ongoing guidance to support integration, deepen trust with your Inner Child, and navigate what unfolds over time.

Seeking ongoing personal support
→ Mindset & Wellbeing Coaching
A grounded, trauma-informed space to work with patterns, relationships, and everyday challenges with clarity and compassion.

Feeling called to train or guide others
→ Inner Child Practitioner Training
An experiential pathway for those wishing to embody this work more deeply and share it with integrity.

Reconnect, heal and rediscover your inner child

Meet, reconnect, and heal with your inner child. This online, workshop-style course is designed to help you rediscover the magic, fun, and love of your inner child, while also healing past wounds, trauma, and limiting beliefs. Together, we explore how childhood experiences and self-sabotaging patterns may be influencing your adult life today.

Everyone has the capacity to connect with their inner child. This workshop offers a safe and supportive space to begin building a trusting relationship with that part of yourself. You’ll learn practical tools and techniques that you can continue using in daily life—helping you reclaim authenticity, confidence, play, and emotional wellbeing.

  • 3 x 2-hour live online sessions via Zoom
  • Guidance from an experienced practitioner specialising in inner child healing
  • Guided meditations and playful exercises to explore between sessions
  • All course materials provided through a private online portal

testimonials.quote: I connected with Amy immediately when we met for that first conversation. I don’t know if I could’ve had as much success without that connection. Amy listened intently to me any time I had a question or wanted to explain why I have some of the issues that I’m trying to resolve. Her patience is immeasurable and her compassion and optimism is vital to this kind of work. She did a beautiful job of moving me through the meditations, which were incredible. After this last session, I can't wait to do the heart space meditations and the regression meditations.

testimonials.title: Testimonial
testimonials.name: Jocelyn
testimonials.subtitle: United States
testimonials.quote: Overall, I was wonderfully impressed with how meaningful the online experience felt, as I much prefer working in person and sometimes struggle to feel connected virtually. Amy was tangibly present, incredibly patient and aware when guiding me through meditations and allowing me to process wounding. I have recommended it to several friends! I continue using the skills I've learned personally, and am finding great value in doing this work.

testimonials.title: Testimonial
testimonials.name: Janice
testimonials.subtitle: United States
testimonials.quote: As a clinical counselor, I have observed most adult patient's mental health issues are from childhood trauma. As I completed this workshop, the most important factor I noticed was observing your inner feelings whether good or bad, toxic or healthy, investigate it, understand it, and know when it's your inner child speaking to you. Give your Inner child a voice and respect to express her/his concerns, needs, and wants. As you help her/him heal you'll become one and transform into the adult you were created to be.

texts:
Having worked in therapeutic settings including counselling, psychoanalytical work and trauma-informed care, I bring a diverse toolkit and a flexible, integrative approach to healing. My experience includes supporting individuals with severe trauma (PTSD, childhood abuse and violence), depression, anxiety, dissociative patterns and eating disorders.

Through this work, I have developed gentle and empowering therapies that honour each person’s unique needs and support self-healing. My intention is always to create a safe, compassionate and nurturing space for transformation.

Since graduating with an MSc in Investigative Forensic Psychology in 2012, I have been deeply committed to developing therapeutic practices that help people understand their healing journey. My approach focuses on tools and frameworks that allow individuals to self-realise their own path, and feel confident sharing what they learn with others.

I invite you to explore the testimonials and additional information to learn more about integrative therapy, trauma-informed support and inner-child healing.

Many of us move through life unaware of the patterns shaping how we think, feel and respond. These early adaptations, created for safety and belonging, often limit our ability to live with freedom and authenticity as adults.

Mindset & Wellbeing Coaching offers a gentle, trauma-informed space to uncover these patterns and reconnect with your true self. Through mindfulness, somatic awareness, and conscious reprogramming, we work together to cultivate clarity, confidence, and emotional balance across all aspects of life.

My approach draws on mindfulness, neuro-linguistic programming (NLP), reparenting, generational healing and conscious relationship work, supporting you to release limiting beliefs, strengthen self-awareness, and realign with your natural rhythm and purpose.

If you feel called to create more harmony, inner confidence and self-understanding, I invite you to connect.

Deepening your journey of healing and integration

Inner Child Mentoring offers continued guidance and support after completing the Inner Child Workshop. This gentle, trauma-informed space helps you integrate insights, strengthen your relationship with your Inner Child, and move through deeper layers of healing with clarity and compassion.

Through reflective dialogue, healing practices and personalised guidance, mentoring supports you in releasing limiting patterns, nurturing emotional safety, and expanding into greater confidence, authenticity and inner trust. Ideal for those wanting ongoing support, deeper exploration, or a long-term healing relationship with their inner world.
Explore Inner Child Mentoring
